lede_html: Awards rose to 76 this week from 58, and EPC items to 142 from 117, but the money went to a few hands. MCC took the two largest metals awards: the US$195m Vinmetal steelmaking package in Vietnam and US$120m of bauxite mining works at Sanmenxia. Voith Hydro won both Slovak pump-turbine and motor-generator packages, and Alstom Ferroviaria took Italian signalling. For a bidder, the pattern is that head contracts are going to integrated contractors and equipment makers. The realistic opening is a subcontract or supply position under them, not the main contract.

deals_why.Torrent regulation in mountain basins, L: Greece's environment and energy ministry is tendering US$87m of flood and erosion works across five forest areas; civil contractors have until 14 January.
deals_why.UKNNL - Fabrication, Machining, Associat: A US$20m open framework from the UK National Nuclear Laboratory gives qualified fabrication and machining workshops a way into nuclear work; bids close 8 December.
deals_why.Vinmetal steelmaking package EPC, Vietna: MCC's US$195m package puts a Chinese metallurgical EPC at the centre of Vinmetal's steelmaking build, so equipment suppliers should be talking to MCC as well as the owner.
deals_why.Sanmenxia Shanzhou South Slope bauxite m: Disclosed in the same filing, this US$120m bauxite contract shows MCC booking mining works at home alongside steel EPC abroad, which ties up its capacity in metals.
deals_why.AUS_Pipelinebau_SPO_Lot 2_Center: This US$119m German pipeline construction lot is now placed, so suppliers of pipe, valves and fittings should go to the awardee for the central section.
deals_why.Railway signalling works: design, extrao: Alstom Ferroviaria's US$104m design, maintenance and upgrade award keeps Italian signalling work with an equipment maker; component suppliers will need to sell through Alstom.
deals_why.Hydraulic turbine pump/turbine moderniza: Voith Hydro's US$73m pump-turbine modernisation, together with its US$37m motor-generator award, gives one manufacturer about US$110m of the Slovak refit.
deals_why.Nouveau tracé Vuisternens - Romont: JPF Construction's US$71m new Vuisternens to Romont alignment is booked; suppliers of aggregates, steel and plant hire should approach the Swiss contractor directly.
deals_why.TG Aéro-souterrains HTA/BT and Programme: EDF is tendering US$64m of MV/LV overhead-to-underground conversion and renovation, which opens work for cable, ducting and civil subcontractors in France.
deals_why.Uzlazne cijevi (tubing), zaštitne cijevi: INA is buying US$51m of tubing, casing and steel pipe in Croatia, a sizeable order for mills and stockists that can meet an oil company's specifications.
deals_why.MotorGenerator – SE Integrator: Voith Hydro also wins this US$37m motor-generator award, so electrical subsuppliers on the Slovak project now report to a single contractor.
deals_why.Rosslare Europort, Berth 3 Upgrade: BAM Contractors is booked for the US$37m Berth 3 upgrade at Rosslare Europort; marine works and steel suppliers should approach BAM, not the port.

flows_why.https://www.freightwaves.com/news/latam-: Latam is building and financing a new cargo terminal at El Dorado in Bogotá, adding air cargo capacity for Colombian flower exporters and their forwarders.
flows_why.https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-Gener: Gulf crude exports are back to 80% to 85% of pre-war levels but refined products are stuck at 35%, so product buyers face tighter supply than crude buyers.
flows_why.https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/tan: Record VLCC rates in October pushed Suezmax and Aframax rates higher, so charterers of dirty tankers paid more in every size class.
flows_why.https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/: Iraq produced 4.6 million bpd in October, its highest since 2019, which means more crude available to buyers and more tanker demand out of the Gulf.
